papers.title: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models
papers.abstract: Introduces OSReward, a benchmark evaluating vision-language models as judges of computer-using agent trajectories. Finds state-of-the-art models have systematic leniency bias; provides OS-Shepherd open reward models at 30-60% lower cost.

papers.title: Interpretable MEG Decoding of Perceived Speech: Cortical Sources and the Stimulus Features That Drive Retrieval
papers.abstract: Short segments of perceived speech can be retrieved from MEG recordings by deep networks trained with a CLIP-style objective. The model achieves 39.75% Top-1 accuracy, with weights mapping to source space recovering speech-perception network generators.

papers.title: From Economic Agents to Agentic Economies: A Systems Blueprint for Economic World Models
papers.abstract: Develops implementation roadmap for economic world models simulating economies through heterogeneous agents, beliefs, and market mechanisms. Organizes EWM systems into six-level capability ladder from rule-based to empirically-aligned sim-to-real twins.

papers.title: DataSpace: Benchmarking Data Agents for Verifiable Analytics over Heterogeneous Workspaces
papers.abstract: Introduces DataSpace benchmark with 410 cross-language tasks and 7,439 artifacts for evaluating data agents on verifiable tabular results. Best accuracy reaches 66.34%; identifies multimodal evidence integration as consistent challenge across models.

papers.title: Teaching Nemotron Greek: Mining a Corpus, Adapting Retrieval, and Grounding Generation for Modern Greek across Specialist Domains
papers.abstract: Adapts Nemotron retrieval stack for Modern Greek across legal, energy, financial, medical domains. Fine-tuned embedder improves nDCG@10 from 0.362 to 0.835; LoRA-tuned reader increases answer correctness from 29.4% to 66.9%.

papers.title: Activity Frames: Deterministic Screen-Activity Compilation for Agent Memory and Replay
papers.abstract: Compiles passively captured screen activity into agent memory with deterministic pipeline. On 128,756 frames over 51 days, reduces daily capture 86x smaller in 68ms; agent answers questions at 98.4% accuracy versus 66-80% for LLM summaries.

papers.title: EffectLearner: World-Aware Object-Effect Reasoning for Real-World Video Object Removal
papers.abstract: Proposes semantic-reasoning framework combining VLM-based Object-Effect Reasoner with DiT-based Video Eraser for comprehensive object-induced effect removal. Outperforms baselines on ROSE-Bench and complex real-world scenarios in EffectWorld dataset.

papers.title: PaDoc: Layout-Grounded Parallel Decoding for Document Parsing
papers.abstract: Layout-grounded parser treating predicted layout as branching structure enabling concurrent regional content decoding. Achieves 91.1 layout F1 and 94.24 overall score; 67.4-118% faster throughput with 39.2-54.9% lower P95 latency.

papers.title: KVAE: Family of Tokenizers for Multimodal Generative Models
papers.abstract: Presents KVAE tokenizers for audio, image, and video designed for text-conditioned generation. Reconstruction and generation results match or surpass frontier tokenizers from Wan-2.2, HunyuanVideo, FLUX.2, MovieGen with public code release.

papers.title: MameLoshnLM: Yiddish Language Model and Evaluation Benchmark
papers.abstract: First open-source 8B-parameter language model for Yiddish with Oytser corpus and Kashes benchmark. Outperforms multilingual baselines; better captures language-defining lexical and morphological patterns than noisy web-scale multilingual data.

cc_updates.body:
Added gateway spend-limit support to Claude Code's usage warning; the limit-reached message now names the cap, its reset time, and the operator's message (requires the gateway on 2.1.225)
Added a workspace trust prompt to `claude agents` for untrusted directories, matching the behavior of `claude`
Fixed a transient 401 replacing a long-lived `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` with a stored login's short-lived token, breaking headless sessions until restart
Fixed MCP OAuth servers on macOS intermittently failing with a burst of 401 errors, as if never authenticated, after a keychain read timed out

Added self-hosted environments: `claude self-hosted-runner` turns your own machines or containers into a place Claude Code web, mobile, and desktop sessions can run, on Team and Enterprise plans
Added `archive` plugin source: install plugins from a zip over HTTPS without git or npm, with optional SHA-256 pinning
Added a cancel-and-confirm step when removing an unavailable paste changes a command's text
Added `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX` env var for Bedrock to prefer a specific cross-region inference profile over the `AWS_REGION`-derived one
